english:
Grants a <void Void Overshield /> with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds. Its HP has 70% Damage Resistance against PvE Combatants, providing 150 effective HP.

Damage to the <void Void Overshield /> does not interrupt Health Regeneration.

Can stack with other overshields, such as those from Turnabout and the Class stat. Overshields absorb damage in the order they were gained, with the oldest layer taking damage first.

// The source gives a 10+5 second duration without identifying what grants the extra 5 seconds.

source.text:
Void Overshield with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds.
Void Overshield's HP portion has 70% Damage Resist (150eHP) against Combatants.

Damage dealt to Void Overshields does not stop Health Regeneration.
Overshield can stack with other overshields, such as Turnabout's OS and Class Stat's OS. Overshield layers are determined by "First In, First Out".
